explicitAbsentSurfaces: every native GPU prototype member outside operations

commonRequestFields.name: operationId
commonRequestFields.requirement: authenticated logical wire ID selected by the generated wrapper and checked against the installed operation set

commonRequestFields.name: operationInstanceId
commonRequestFields.requirement: nonzero monotonic per realm for every service call; never reused after rejection cancellation or completion

commonRequestFields.name: promiseId
commonRequestFields.requirement: distinct nonzero identity only for Promise-bearing work; zero for non-Promise service work

commonRequestFields.name: receiverRef
commonRequestFields.requirement: carrier-level typed full-generation service receiver for every service call; object methods preserve the wrapper receiver, while realm-level GPU calls derive a nonzero GPU singleton reference from authenticated realm identity even though the public wrapper has no receiver handle

commonRequestFields.name: wrapperAllocatedTargetRef
commonRequestFields.requirement: typed full-generation reference for synchronous service-enqueue creators and null otherwise

commonRequestFields.name: sealedLocalTimelinePrefix
commonRequestFields.requirement: bounded canonical zero-or-more pending wrapper-local operation records with operation instance device-ingress and captured-scope provenance

commonRequestFields.name: argumentBody
commonRequestFields.requirement: selected only by authenticated operation ID; includes scope/barrier or sealed command records where required

commonCompletionFields.name: realmToken
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact open realm token

commonCompletionFields.name: realmGeneration
commonCompletionFields.requirement: current nonzero realm generation

commonCompletionFields.name: accountToken
commonCompletionFields.requirement: structurally carried account token

commonCompletionFields.name: accountGeneration
commonCompletionFields.requirement: current nonzero account generation

commonCompletionFields.name: topology
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact authenticated provider topology for the admitted operation

commonCompletionFields.name: logicalDeviceId
commonCompletionFields.requirement: owning logical device or zero only for adapter discovery

commonCompletionFields.name: logicalDeviceGeneration
commonCompletionFields.requirement: current logical device generation or zero only for adapter discovery

commonCompletionFields.name: providerGeneration
commonCompletionFields.requirement: owning provider generation or zero before provider allocation

commonCompletionFields.name: authorityContextDigest
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact admitted authority-context digest

commonCompletionFields.name: operationId
commonCompletionFields.requirement: must match one pending authenticated operation

commonCompletionFields.name: operationInstanceId
commonCompletionFields.requirement: must match one admitted monotonic operation instance

commonCompletionFields.name: promiseId
commonCompletionFields.requirement: must match the pending Promise or be zero for non-Promise work

commonCompletionFields.name: adapterOperationOrdinal
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact adapter-operation ordinal or zero when not applicable

commonCompletionFields.name: deviceIngressOrdinal
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact device ingress ordinal or zero when not applicable

commonCompletionFields.name: queueIngressOrdinal
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact queue ingress ordinal or zero when not applicable

commonCompletionFields.name: physicalSequence
commonCompletionFields.requirement: exact admitted provider sequence or zero before provider admission

commonCompletionFields.name: receiverRef
commonCompletionFields.requirement: same nonzero typed full-generation service receiver reference as the admitted request, including the realm-derived GPU singleton

commonCompletionFields.name: wrapperAllocatedTargetRef
commonCompletionFields.requirement: same typed full-generation target reference as the admitted request or null

commonCompletionFields.name: capturedScopeId
commonCompletionFields.requirement: captured error scope identity or zero when not applicable

commonCompletionFields.name: status

commonCompletionFields.name: completionBody
commonCompletionFields.requirement: selected by authenticated pending operation; never a caller-provided result tag

publicArguments.wireShape: complete pinned GPUBindGroupLayoutDescriptor structural vocabulary after Web IDL conversion; the authenticated TypeGPU workloads are an exercised service-validation subset, not a request-codec vocabulary restriction

complete pinned GPUPipelineLayoutDescriptor after Web IDL conversion: owned label, nullable sequence of complete branded GPUBindGroupLayout references, and u32 immediateSize; reviewed TypeGPU workload bounds are applied only after decode

serviceArguments.wireShape: full typed GPU-singleton receiver derived from authenticated realm identity plus converted options and authority/account snapshot; the public wrapper receiver remains null and is never forwarded as the carrier receiver
adapter receiver plus generated logical provider descriptor and result-selection identity; never raw GPUDeviceDescriptor
canvas-context receiver plus converted configuration and complete current target/account authority
device receiver plus wrapper-allocated command-encoder target and converted descriptor
device receiver plus wrapper-allocated pipeline target, converted descriptor, and shader handle refs
device receiver plus wrapper-allocated shader target and converted WGSL descriptor
device receiver plus wrapper-mirrored scope identity/filter and authenticated device-ingress predecessor

texture receiver plus wrapper-allocated view target, converted descriptor, and for a wrapper-local current texture its complete mint origin/provenance tuple; unknown texture receivers never materialize ambiently
device receiver plus exact scope identity, captured device-ingress barrier, and sealed pending-local prefix through that barrier

queue receiver plus bounded single-use command-buffer records; each record authenticates its logical operation identity, device-ingress/captured-scope provenance, device/generation, render-pass order, texture-view/pipeline refs, draw arguments, finish state, and canonical command-program digest
device receiver plus idempotent terminal intent
texture receiver plus idempotent terminal intent; an unmaterialized current texture carries its complete mint origin and is retired without ambient materialization
canvas-context receiver plus exact attachment/context/configuration identity and idempotent cleanup intent
device receiver plus wrapper-allocated bind-group-layout target and canonical converted descriptor; logical capability and pinned-workload validation occurs after native decode

device receiver plus wrapper-allocated pipeline-layout target and complete converted descriptor with nullable full bind-group-layout references; workload and logical-limit validation occurs after native decode

serviceCompletions.wireShape: empty success or typed device-timeline error keyed to the full admitted completion correlation identity
null or fresh adapter identity plus compatibility/account settlement state
live device identity plus stable queue/lost identities, or one self-contained ASSIGNED + NOT_ADMITTED service-detached already-lost result whose wrapper settlement requires no lifecycle tombstone
nullable typed GPUError value after exact scope barrier

null or fresh adapter identity plus a required authenticated serviceDetachedExpired u8; zero retains a live service attachment and credits, one denotes a post-positive-commit close settlement with no retained service object, credits, or provider handle

externalOrigins.GPUCanvasContext: generation-fenced Exact CanvasHandle/context attachment seam; currently unwired; unknown context handles are rejected and never ambiently materialized
externalOrigins.GPUTexture.current: getCurrentTexture mints a wrapper-local epoch identity and sealed mint-operation provenance; createView, destroy, queue submit, or a popErrorScope prefix flush carries and validates its context/attachment/configuration/current-epoch origin without ambient materialization
